name: Princess room personal decor
prompt:
Create ONE detailed source-compatible GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, not a mesh or whole new room. Title INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001 — Princess room personal decor. Pale ivory background, soft even light, crisp isolated non-melting forms. Full sheet ID, numbered suffix and names printed clearly, dimensions W,D,H marked PROPOSED. Same original rose/ivory marble, fine gold rose/star/lotus ornament, indigo and blush textiles. Use only single supplied reference for visible style; unseen construction is proposed. No people, scenery or unlabeled extra objects. Exactly12 separate object cells with readable shape, one three-quarter or unfolded primary view and a small rear/underside/contact view. Do not fuse objects together. TWELVE separate readable cells in4x3 grid. These are tiny desktop/vanity accessories, not new furniture. Gold/ivory/blush/cobalt accents match source. Keep hooks, teeth, hinges and contact faces clear. Do not invent full room, vases, duplicate serving trays, picture-frame masters, gift packs, lamps or wall mirrors.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A01 — Rose jewel casket. W,D,H [0.28, 0.18, 0.16]m proposed. One small ivory casket, rose enamel inset, gold lotus feet, hinged lid; main view closed and small open interior inset. Not a gift box.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A02 — Star perfume bottle. W,D,H [0.08, 0.06, 0.16]m proposed. One small cobalt crystal perfume bottle with gold star stopper and delicate blush enamel label, flat stable base.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A03 — Pearl scent atomizer. W,D,H [0.12, 0.08, 0.14]m proposed. One ivory/blush pear-shaped scent bottle with thin gold neck and separate-looking soft pump bulb, not a lantern.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A04 — Small handheld mirror. W,D,H [0.12, 0.025, 0.27]m proposed. One small oval hand mirror with ivory/gold rose handle, reflective centre and carved back shown. This is NOT the existing full-size moon wall mirror.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A05 — Princess hairbrush. W,D,H [0.08, 0.035, 0.23]m proposed. One handheld ivory hairbrush with gold rose-inlaid back and clearly visible short bristles underneath, human sized.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A06 — Gold comb. W,D,H [0.13, 0.005, 0.045]m proposed. One fine gold comb with aligned visible teeth, blush rose crest on upper spine, no melted teeth.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A07 — Ring display stand. W,D,H [0.07, 0.07, 0.09]m proposed. One tiny ivory conical ring stand on rose-marble round foot, restrained gold rim; no jewelry needed to define shape.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A08 — Petal trinket dish. W,D,H [0.15, 0.15, 0.035]m proposed. One small shallow ivory lotus-petal trinket bowl with rose glaze interior and gold rim. Underside has stable flat foot.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A09 — Keepsake locket. W,D,H [0.035, 0.008, 0.045]m proposed. One tiny gold oval locket, rose enamel star on outside; show open hinged state with empty inset, short attachment eye only, no long tangled chain.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A10 — Silk eye mask. W,D,H [0.2, 0.02, 0.09]m proposed. One blush silk sleep mask with gold star embroidery and clear elastic strap loop behind. Soft fabric, not a mask sculpture.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A11 — Lace tabletop doily. W,D,H [0.32, 0.32, 0.003]m proposed. One thin ivory star/rose lace doily, circular silhouette with readable repeating lace holes, laid flat; no tray underneath.

INT-BEDROOM-PROP-001-A12 — Rose drawer pull. W,D,H [0.1, 0.035, 0.035]m proposed. One small gold rose drawer handle with TWO short rear mounting pegs, shown from front and back. Not a complete drawer, cabinet or generic lantern bracket.
Footer: Proposed reference components; shape consistency, fit and mesh separation require modeling review.
